timestamp_note: Saved before observing probe-refinement outcomes; the source dataset has already been used for prior exploratory search.
research_question: Does observing one depth frame per event improve benefit estimation enough to justify its mandatory probe cost, compared with allocation from RGB alone?
setting: Offline recorded-event batch; encode RGB for all events; at positive feasible budgets encode one temporal-centre depth frame for every event; choose RGB fallback or one/three/six/up-to-twelve depth-frame score. No future-online or sensor purchase saving claim.
cost: Probe is charged even if final score reverts to RGB; marginal cost max(min(k,n)-1,0); all mandatory probe frames are paid before refinement. Nested temporal frame order prevents recomputing the probe.
training_target: Training-animal leave-one-out |y-f_RGB|-|y-f_action|, inherited from independently fitted action scorers; fixed validation-selected base parameter identities.
gate: RBF KRR, training-median bandwidth multiplier .5/1/2; alpha .01/.1/1/10/100. Probe gate uses frozen RGB+one-depth descriptors; comparison uses RGB-only features with the same mandatory probe costs.
selection: Mean validation routed MAE at .25/.5/.75 caps; no test reference enters gate, action choice or allocation.
primary_endpoint: Event MAE averaged over .25/.5/.75 declared caps; also full resource curve, per-animal and per-class MAE, RMSE, rounded accuracy and quadratic kappa. All events must be scored.
ablation_logic: Same action scorers, animals, sample pool, descriptor encoder and cost accounting; vary only gate observation, target construction or allocator. Compare prior no-probe allocation separately under the same total depth-frame cap.
statistics: Nominal fixed-model paired animal-cluster bootstrap; source exploration is disclosed; no equivalence margin selected after seeing results.
